mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_PASSWORD , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , U.USER_STATUS , U.USER_ENABLED , C.COM_NAME , C.COM_INFO , C.COM_NUM , C.COM_EMAIL , C.COM_URL , C.COM_CREATE_YEAR , C.COM_MEM , C.COM_LOGO , C.COM_PAYMENT , C.INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM COMPANY C JOIN USERS U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_PASSWORD , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , U.USER_STATUS , U.USER_ENABLED , C.COM_NAME , C.COM_INFO , C.COM_NUM , C.COM_EMAIL , C.COM_URL , C.COM_CREATE_YEAR , C.COM_MEM , C.COM_LOGO , C.COM_PAYMENT , C.INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM COMPANY C JOIN USERS U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'COMP'|| LPAD(NVL(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MAX(USER_ID), LENGTH('COMP' ) + 1)), 0) + 1, 6, '0') FROM COMPANY
INSERT INTO COMPANY ( USER_ID, COM_NAME, COM_INFO, COM_NUM, COM_EMAIL, COM_URL, COM_CREATE_YEAR, COM_MEM, COM_LOGO, COM_PAYMENT, INDUSTRY_TYPE) VALUES( #{userId}, #{comName}, #{comInfo}, #{comNum}, #{comEmail}, #{comUrl}, #{comCreateYear}, #{comMem}, #{comLogo}, #{comPayment}, #{industryType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMPANY SET COM_NAME = #{comName}, COM_INFO = #{comInfo}, COM_NUM = #{comNum}, COM_EMAIL = #{comEmail}, COM_URL = #{comUrl}, COM_CREATE_YEAR = #{comCreateYear}, COM_MEM = #{comMem}, COM_LOGO = #{comLogo}, COM_PAYMENT = #{comPayment}, INDUSTRY_TYPE = #{industryType} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
